text:
auditor_jane: Hi team — for the SOC2 field visit tomorrow we need a compact package showing: recent RBAC changes (last 90 days), associated audit log extracts proving approval + execution, KMS key access events for any changes, and links to the vuln triage tickets that prompted RBAC tweaks. Can you confirm what you can deliver by EOD?

sam_engsec: Ack. We can assemble a package. Quick Q: do you want full diffs of rolebindings or just a CSV of changed principals + scope?

auditor_jane: CSV of changed principals + scope is fine, but we also need one example end-to-end proof: PR/approval -> deploy -> audit log entry -> KMS event if key used.

amelia_oncall: tagging @sam_engsec and @mike_infra — i'll pull the 90d rolebinding changes from staging + prod and export as CSV. Will include who approved the PR (GH link). ETA 5pm PT.

mike_infra: I can pull CloudTrail/Splunk snippets for the corresponding ops activity. For KMS events, we have key usage logs in CloudTrail for AWS KMS and in GCP's audit logs for CMEK — which environment do you need?

auditor_jane: Both prod and staging ideally, but prod is highest priority. If you only can do prod today that's ok.

sam_engsec: I'll map RBAC changes -> GitHub PRs and add the PR IDs to the CSV. For the approval trail, do you accept a screenshot of the PR approvals + URL?

auditor_jane: URL + screenshot is fine. Also need timestamps that match audit logs.

irfan_ops: Pasting the Splunk query i'll use to extract the api-server audit events for rolebinding changes:

```splunk
index=k8s_logs event_type=rolebinding OR event_type=clusterrolebinding
| where _time >= relative_time(now(), "-90d@d")
| table _time user action resource namespace request_body.pr_name request_id
```

irfan_ops: For CloudTrail KMS usage:

```sql
-- Athena on s3 CloudTrail parquet
SELECT eventTime, eventName, userIdentity.principalId, requestParameters.keyId, resources
FROM cloudtrail_parquet
WHERE eventName IN ('GenerateDataKey', 'Encrypt', 'ReEncrypt', 'Decrypt')
AND eventTime >= date_add('day', -90, current_date)
```

sam_engsec: Nice. i'll correlate PR timestamps to the request_id in the apiserver logs. Also adding a small mapping file that ties PR -> cluster -> rolebinding name.

auditor_jane: For vulnerability triage links: we need the ticket IDs (JIRA) that led to the RBAC change and the remediation summary. If the change was unrelated to a vuln, mark N/A.

amelia_oncall: FYI — one of the RBAC changes was from CVE-2025-1021 triage (JIRA: SEC-4521). i'll include the ticket and a 2-sentence remediation summary in the CSV.

mike_infra: Uploading logs now to the evidence bucket (presigned link below). Link valid 24h: <https://evidence.redwood.example/signed/abcd1234>

sam_engsec: Adding the PR + approval screenshots to the package. Also creating a one-page control mapping doc that shows where these artifacts satisfy SOC2 CC6.2 / ISO A.9.2.

auditor_jane: Perfect. Last ask — please include a short README.md in the package with file descriptions and the contact person for any follow-ups.

irfan_ops: Will do. Also adding a minimal timeline.csv with these columns: event_time, component, actor, action, evidence_ref.

amelia_oncall: ETA recap: CSVs + PR links + screenshots + Splunk/Athena snippets + KMS event extract + README + control mapping doc. Delivering by 17:00 PT.

auditor_jane: Thanks all — if anything slips ping me here. Otherwise i'll review once package is uploaded. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: new-artifact uploaded to evidence-bucket/engsec/1770011223-package.zip (size: 3.2MB) :package:

sam_engsec: Confirmed I can access the package and the README lists sam_engsec as primary contact. I'll stand by for any follow-ups.

amelia_oncall: copying artifacts into compliance-drive and emailing the auditor package link to the audit team. Done.

auditor_jane: Received the email and confirmed download. Quick initial check looks good — i'll follow up tomorrow with any clarifying q's. Thanks everyone.
